Balanced barrel.

  •  Slightly increases handling speed

Weighty barrel extension.
  •  Increases range
  •  Decreases handling speed
  •  Moderately controls recoil

perks.name: Fluted Barrel
perks.desc:
Ultra-light barrel. 
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Full Bore
perks.desc:
Barrel optimized for distance.
  •  Greatly increases range
  •  Decreases stability
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Hammer-Forged Rifling

Durable ranged barrel.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Polygonal Rifling
perks.desc:
Barrel optimized for recoil reduction.
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Smallbore
perks.desc:
Dual strength barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Full Choke
perks.desc: Tightened barrel. Reduces projectile spread when aiming down sights at the cost of precision damage.

perks.name: Rifled Barrel
perks.desc:
Ranged shotgun barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Greatly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Accelerated Heatsink
perks.desc: Slightly reduces damage in exchange for improved cooling.

perks.name: Overclocked Heatsink
perks.desc: Slightly increases damage in exchange for reduced cooling.

perks.name: Enhanced Heatsink
perks.desc: Strong battery life. Reduces heat generation.

perks.name: Ionized Heatsink
perks.desc: A large, heavy battery. Increases the time it takes to vent, in exchange for greatly reduced heat generation.

perks.name: Particle Repeater
perks.desc:
Improves stability. 
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Projection Fuse
perks.desc:
Distance optimizations.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Light Heatsink
perks.desc: Lightweight, agile battery. Increases handling and vent speed.

perks.name: Tactical Heatsink
perks.desc: This weapon has multiple small improvements. Slightly improves stability, vent speed, and range.

perks.name: Repulsor Brace
perks.desc: Defeating a Void-debuffed target grants an overshield.

perks.name: Loose Change
perks.desc: Applying an elemental debuff to a target increases this weapon's reload speed, aim assist, and movement while aiming down sights for a short duration.

perks.name: Delicate Tuning
perks.desc: While at low heat, this weapon has improved range, handling, and accuracy.

perks.name: Cooling Baubles
perks.desc:
Collecting an Elemental pickup, collecting an Orb of Power, or destroying a Tangle reduces heat.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.name: Rapid Hit
perks.desc: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed.

perks.name: Destabilizing Rounds
perks.desc: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for a short duration.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Master of Arms
perks.desc: Kills with any weapon improve this weapon's damage for a short time.

perks.name: Withering Gaze
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon for a short period of time without firing grants the ability to weaken the next target. Timer resets after firing or when you stop aiming down sights.

perks.name: Thermal Atomization
perks.desc: While at high heat, this weapon deals increased damage and causes targets to explode when defeated.

perks.name: Demoralize
perks.desc: Precision final blows cause nearby targets to become weakened.

perks.name: Meganeura
perks.desc: Precision final blows create an elemental damage explosion that deals more damage based on the number of rapid precision hits dealt beforehand.

perks.name: Headseeker
perks.desc: Body shots landed with this weapon increase precision damage and aim assist for a short time. Body shots landed while the perk is active refresh the time.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.desc: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Imperial Allegiance
perks.desc: Being near allies grants increased cooling or charge rate, and increased damage while at high heat or low guard energy.

notes: Inspired by @CourtProjects, @Saint_Kabr and and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-Utility PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for single-target damage against tougher enemies in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content, particularly for void builds. High Tyrant is a Balanced Heat frame pulse rifle, with a rapid-fire firing rate, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic tiering spreadsheet https://linktr.ee/TheAegisRelic offering much the same performance as other pulses. The heat frame is like an extra perk set, first providing reduced heat generation, significantly increasing the number of shots before overheating, and providing a pseudo-Reconstruction, automatically "refilling" as the weapon loses heat when not being used. Additionally, there's an intrinsic ×1.15 damage boost against orange and yellow bars and vehicles, plus a ×2 vent rate if you manually reload when the heat bar is at >87.5% of maximum heat to proc Perfect Vent, as per the https://www.destiny2.science/ Destiny Data Compendium. The stats are decent by comparison with other rapid-fire scouts - see https://d2foundry.gg/w/2873508409 for how the weapon stats impact in-game performance, once the formulas have been worked out. Something that helps control recoil is very helpful with the barrel perk. and in the heatsink perk, look for something that reduces heat generation, or improves cooling efficiency or vent speed. For a utility roll to use with the void fragment toolkit, and that helps with damage output for you and your fireteam, in the second trait perk column Withering Gaze Weakens targets for ×1.15 damage for a refreshable 6s after ADS-ing for 1.4s (1.3s when enhanced), but if the stronger ×1.3 weaken has been applied from Tractor Cannon or Shadowshot, a proc will reapply at the higher value. You could pair that against weaker enemies with Repulsor Brace for a ×0.5 damage resisting void overshield 8s (10s when enhanced) on killing your weakened enemy, Loose Change to provide +50 Vent Speed +20 Aim Assist and ×1.2 ADS movement speed after you apply weaken, or Rapid Hit to stack up to 5 times on crit hits for a max +25 Stability and +60 Vent Speed with a ×0.92 animation multiplier for a refreshable 2s to help land crits on your weakened target. The Origin Trait, Imperial Allegiance grants a stack for each ally in 15m, up to ×3, to boost both the cooling rate and damage when heat is >50% by up to a max of ×1.105, so is ideal for working in a fireteam. If you're interested, this is modelled on the A280C blaster rifle, the preferred weapon of Rebel Alliance Special Forces. Recommended MW: Cooling Efficiency, with a Heat Generated mod or your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.
